Argument.description: One named expression argument in a Function call.

name.description: Name of the Function parameter to which the argument binds.

Argument.title: Argument

Assembly.description: An Entity identifying a collection of Entities and Relationships. Members are referenced by identity and may belong to more than one Assembly. Membership does not imply spatial containment or duplicate its members.

characteristics.description: The Entity's labels and named values.

classification.description: Classification describing the object, referenced by its stable UUID.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique among all Entities and Assemblies in the Model. Renaming it preserves UUID identity and references.

entities.description: Unordered, unique UUIDs of member Entities, including nested Assemblies.

id.description: Stable identity of the Entity, distinct from a Model revision.

name.description: Human-readable display name; not used as identity.

relationships.description: Unordered, unique UUIDs of member Relationships.

Assembly.title: Assembly

Assignment.description: An explicit target and its supplied content, a finite Quantity for a scalar Value or a Movement, or a date or NEVER for a date Value; its collection determines assignment or estimate semantics.

date.description: The calendar date supplied to a date Value; it excludes quantity and never.

never.description: Supplies NEVER to a date Value, the event does not happen; it excludes quantity and date.

quantity.description: Explicit finite magnitude and compatible units for a scalar Value or a Movement; omission or null is not a supplied amount.

target.description: Value or Movement to which the content is supplied.

Assignment.title: Assignment

Binding.description: A local interface name that refers to an existing canonical Value by UUID.

name.description: Case-sensitive local interface name; not reference identity.

value.description: UUID of the shared Value. Its declaration supplies its kind, Measure, and content.

Binding.title: Binding

Call.description: Application of an identified Function to positional and named expression arguments.

function.description: UUID of the Function that the call applies.

named_arguments.description: Named arguments with unique parameter names. Their order is retained for authoring, not positional binding.

Call.title: Call

Cardinality.description: How many Values a projection permits for each Entity.
Cardinality.title: Cardinality

Characteristics.description: A collection of Labels and Values belonging to an Entity or Relationship. Each Label or Value has a stable UUID and a key unique within its collection.

labels.description: Identified labels with explicit owner-local keys, unique within this collection.

values.description: Identified values with explicit owner-local keys, unique within this collection.

Characteristics.title: Characteristics

Check.description: One record of a decision trace, a window date of a rule or the date on which the rule took otherwise.

condition.description: The result of the condition. Absent or null means unknown, or that this record tested no condition.

earliest.description: The earliest bound of the window on this date. Absent or null means no bound, or an undecided bound.

key.description: The key of that Value in the input Model.

latest.description: The latest bound of the window on this date. Absent or null means no bound, or an undecided bound.

observations.description: The values that the condition read, in the order of the condition. Absent or null means that this record tested no condition.

target.description: The Value that the rule decides, which identifies the rule.

value.description: The value that this record fixes. It is present when the result is decided or otherwise, and only then.

Check.title: Check

Claim.description: Sourced, asserted, or derived candidate content and its supporting lineage.

content.description: Candidate content; its structure depends on the supported target.

id.description: Stable identity of the Claim, referenced by Facts and by dependent Claims.

kind.description: Whether the content is sourced, asserted or derived.

method.description: Process used to obtain the content; required for asserted and derived Claims.

sources.description: Source Locations or UUID references to upstream Claims.

Claim.title: Claim

ClaimKind.description: How a Claim obtained its content.
ClaimKind.title: ClaimKind

Classification.description: A named definition node in a taxonomy hierarchy.

code.description: Case-sensitive code unique within its Taxonomy; descriptive metadata, not reference identity.

definition.description: Optional explanatory text; an empty string is permitted.

id.description: Stable identity across code changes and Model revisions.

name.description: Nonblank human-readable name.

parent.description: Parent Classification in the same Taxonomy, referenced by UUID. An absent or null parent denotes a root candidate.

Classification.title: Classification

CollectionKind.description: Whether a collection is ordered and whether it keeps repeated elements.
CollectionKind.title: CollectionKind

CompletionStatus.description: How an execution attempt ended, apart from its mathematical conclusion.
CompletionStatus.title: CompletionStatus

Constraint.description: An identified requirement that a referenced Boolean Expression be true in the context where the Constraint is imposed.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique within its Constraint collection; not reference identity. Renaming it preserves UUID references.

description.description: Explanation of the requirement and its purpose.

id.description: Stable identity of the Constraint across Model revisions.

name.description: Human-readable display name; not used as identity.

predicate.description: UUID reference to the Expression required to be true. Reference existence and a Boolean result domain require semantic validation beyond record shape.

Constraint.title: Constraint

Content.description: Candidate content whose structure and meaning depend on the supported target. Content must be validated against that target before a Fact is accepted; this generic envelope does not make arbitrary content executable.
Content.title: Content

ContentEntry.description: One key-value entry of mapping content.

value.description: Content of the value for the key.

ContentEntry.title: ContentEntry

ContentKind.description: The type of a piece of property content; it decides how text and the other fields are read.
ContentKind.title: ContentKind

Criterion.description: Require an Entity Label with this owner-local key to include a Classification, or one of its sub-types.

classification.description: UUID of the Classification that the Label must include.

exclusive.description: True when only the Classification itself matches; when absent, its sub-types in its Taxonomy also match.

Criterion.title: Criterion

DecidedValue.description: The value that a rule fixed on one path, and its decision date.

decision_date.description: The date on which the rule fixed the value.

key.description: The key of that Value in the input Model.

target.description: The Value that the rule decides, which identifies the rule.

value.description: The value that the rule fixed.

DecidedValue.title: DecidedValue

DecisionResult.description: The result of one check of a decision rule.
DecisionResult.title: DecisionResult

Definitions.description: Reusable Taxonomies, Measures, and Functions identified by stable UUIDs within a Model.

functions.description: Exact versioned Function contracts used by calls in this Model. Implementations and their capabilities are selected separately.

measures.description: Measures of this Model; codes are unique within the collection.

taxonomies.description: Taxonomies of this Model; codes are unique within the collection.

Definitions.title: Definitions

Depth.description: How many edges a traversal step follows.
Depth.title: Depth

Diagnostic.description: A coded finding and optional numerical evidence, qualified by document revision.

document.description: Revision containing the referenced target, or the document addressed as a whole.

message.description: Explanation and, for numerical findings, the checking convention.

references.description: Participating Values and Movements in this Run's input Model. Batch findings and attempts without a valid input Model cannot carry these references.

residual.description: Finite signed residual under the stated convention.

target.description: UUID of a canonical record in document; never an unqualified cross-revision reference.

tolerance.description: Finite nonnegative tolerance in compatible units.

values.description: Named inputs and evidence of the finding, as one JSON object; the code gives the names.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

DiagnosticValues.description: A JSON object of named diagnostic inputs and evidence; its names depend on the diagnostic code. Numbers are finite.
DiagnosticValues.title: DiagnosticValues

Direction.description: The direction in which a traversal step follows a Relationship.
Direction.title: Direction

Distribution.description: Serializable distribution parameters, with explicit units; no live random generator.

kind.description: Distribution family, which is uniform, triangular or PERT.

lower.description: Finite lower bound of the support, in units.

mode.description: Finite most likely value, between lower and upper; semantic checks require it for triangular and PERT.

units.description: Units of lower, upper and mode.

upper.description: Finite upper bound of the support, in units; it is not less than lower.

weighting.description: Finite nonnegative weighting of the mode in a PERT distribution; absence means 4.

Distribution.title: Distribution

Domain.description: The permitted content of an argument or result, including its kind, compatible units, measurement meaning, and collection elements where applicable.

collection_kind.description: Optional collection shape required by this signature.

kind.description: The category of content permitted by this Domain.

measure.description: Optional exact measurement meaning required for a measurement or Flow.

units.description: Optional compatible units required for Quantity content. Omission leaves units unconstrained by the signature; a concrete Quantity still requires explicit units.

Domain.title: Domain

DomainKind.description: The kind of content that a Domain accepts or a Function gives.
DomainKind.title: DomainKind

DuplicateHandling.description: Whether a Query keeps or removes repeated projected identities.
DuplicateHandling.title: DuplicateHandling

EmptyHandling.description: What a Function gives for an empty collection.
EmptyHandling.title: EmptyHandling

Entity.description: An identifiable domain object, such as an apartment, building, or actor. Its identity persists across immutable Model revisions. Loading its definition does not execute calculations.

characteristics.description: The Entity's labels and named values.

classification.description: Classification describing the object, referenced by its stable UUID.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique among all Entities and Assemblies in the Model. Renaming it preserves UUID identity and references.

id.description: Stable identity of the Entity, distinct from a Model revision.

name.description: Human-readable display name; not used as identity.

Entity.title: Entity

Entry.description: A named text component of a source address.

key.description: Nonblank name of the address part, such as sheet or cell.

value.description: Nonblank text of the address part.

Entry.title: Entry

Entry__identifier_optional.description: A named text component of a source address.

key.description: Nonblank name of the address part, such as sheet or cell.

value.description: Nonblank text of the address part.

Entry__identifier_optional.title: Entry

Expression.description: An identified mathematical expression. Its kind determines its content; nested expressions retain order and UUID references resolve in the applicable Model or composed Specification scope.

boolean.description: Boolean literal; false is a literal, not absence.

call.description: Function call content of a call Expression.

date.description: Calendar date of a date Expression; it excludes never.

id.description: Stable identity of this Expression across Model revisions.

kind.description: Form of the Expression; it determines which content field is present.

never.description: Records that the event of a date Expression does not happen; it excludes date.

operand.description: Operand of unary negation or Boolean negation.

operands.description: Two ordered operands of a binary operator. Unary operators use operand; Function calls use their own signature.

operator.description: Operator of a unary or binary Expression; absent for other kinds.

quantity.description: Numerical literal with an explicit magnitude and units, independent of any Measure. Use dimensionless for unitless content. Zero is a literal, not absence.

query.description: Embedded graph query of a query Expression; the Expression owns it.

selection.description: Member or index selection content of a selection Expression.

target.description: Explicit Value or Movement symbol; never implicit recorded content.

Expression.title: Expression

ExpressionKind.description: The form of an Expression; it decides which content field is present.
ExpressionKind.title: ExpressionKind

Fact.description: Supporting Claims for the recorded state of one graph object or characteristic.

claims.description: Unique UUIDs of supporting Claims; at least one is required.

reconciliation.description: Optional explicit selection of one supporting Claim when the Claims conflict.

target.description: The actual graph object or characteristic being supported, referenced by its stable UUID.

Fact.title: Fact

Filter.description: Conjunctive tests of Entity metadata and recorded Values, as data. A missing value never passes a test.

classification.description: Classification that a candidate Entity must have, with its sub-types unless exclusive.

exclusive.description: True when only the Classification itself matches; when absent, its sub-types in its Taxonomy also match.

labels.description: All listed Label conditions must hold.

tests.description: All listed Value tests must hold.

Filter.title: Filter

Flow.description: Ordered temporal quantities owned by one Value. Dates are coordinates, not units. Empty, unresolved and zero movements are distinct. The overall model logic defines the meaning of the quantities and selects their calculations; a Flow carries no semantic kind or basis.

movements.description: Ordered Movements; an empty list is a Flow with no entries.

units.description: Units of every Movement magnitude in this Flow.

Flow.title: Flow

Formulation.description: An identified mathematical container with explicit local declarations, expressions, and asserted constraints. Formulations may contain child Formulations and bind names to shared Values.

bindings.description: Local interface names referring to existing Values, including local Values.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique among sibling Formulations; not reference identity.

constraints.description: Canonical assertions owned by this Formulation, referencing Boolean Expressions by UUID.

description.description: Explanation of the mathematical purpose of this Formulation.

expressions.description: Root Expressions owned by this Formulation; their nested operands remain owned within their expression trees. Constraints may reference any eligible Expression in the applicable scope.

formulations.description: Canonical child Formulations owned by this Formulation. Repeated or cyclic containment is invalid.

id.description: Stable identity of this Formulation across Model revisions.

name.description: Human-readable display name.

values.description: Canonical declarations owned by this Formulation. Values already owned elsewhere are referenced, not repeated here.

Formulation.title: Formulation

Function.description: An identified, versioned contract for a pure mathematical or domain function, independent of a particular runtime implementation.

code.description: Case-sensitive code unique within the Model Function collection; not reference identity.

empty_collection.description: Required for functions with collection arguments. Zero is permitted only when the result domain and units can be established without reading a member.

id.description: Stable identity of the Function, referenced by calls.

name.description: Human-readable function name.

parameters.description: Ordered signature. Omission denotes no parameters.

semantics.description: Mathematical meaning, argument conventions, domain restrictions, and exceptional cases.

unit_rule.description: How result units follow from the arguments, or why units do not apply. This rule requires semantic implementation; prose is not an executable unit checker.

Function.title: Function

Geometry.description: One exact provider dataset and explicit Entity associations, owned by this Model.

mappings.description: Associations of Entities or Assemblies with typed source elements in the pinned dataset.

pin.description: Exact pin of the provider dataset that this Model owns.

Geometry.title: Geometry

GeometryElement.description: A typed identity in the pinned provider dataset. Namespace and scope remain explicit; mesh IDs are not source-object identities.

key.description: Nonempty provider-defined identifier of the element in its namespace.

kind.description: Element kind; RK accepts object or group.

namespace.description: Provider-defined namespace of the element key.

placement.description: Optional ordered placement path that selects one placement of the element.

scope.description: Optional provider-defined scope that qualifies the key.

GeometryElement.title: GeometryElement

GeometryFile.description: One retained native file, addressed relative to the Geometry root.

path.description: Relative POSIX path under the Geometry root, without empty, dot or parent segments.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the file bytes.

GeometryFile.title: GeometryFile

GeometryMapping.description: One Entity or Assembly corresponds to one exact typed source element. This is not provenance.

element.description: Typed source element in the pinned dataset that corresponds to the Entity.

entity.description: UUID of the mapped Entity or Assembly in this Model.

GeometryMapping.title: GeometryMapping

GeometryPin.description: Exact native content and its source contract. Paths and source addresses do not replace integrity.

content_digest.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the file inventory sorted by path; validation recomputes it from files.

files.description: Inventory of the retained native files; each path is unique.

format.description: Code that names the native dataset format.

format_version.description: Version of the native dataset format.

provider.description: Code that names the Geometry provider; with format and format_version, it selects the provider adapter.

source_address.description: Optional address of the source dataset; it does not replace the digests.

source_version.description: Optional version of the source dataset at the source address.

specification.description: Immutable upstream specification identifier, such as a full commit URL.

specification_digest.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the pinned upstream specification.

GeometryPin.title: GeometryPin

Implementation.description: An implementation role and its reproducible software identity as reported for this execution.

name.description: Nonblank implementation name.

version.description: Nonblank version or immutable build identifier.

Implementation.title: Implementation

ImplementationKind.description: The role of an implementation that a Run records.
ImplementationKind.title: ImplementationKind

Label.description: A named set of Classifications describing an aspect of an Entity or Relationship.

classifications.description: Unique UUID references to Classifications describing this aspect.

id.description: Stable identity of the Label, used by provenance Facts.

key.description: Name unique within the owner's characteristics.labels collection.

Label.title: Label

name.description: Name of the dependency, such as python.

Location.description: An address within a specific Source edition.

anyOf.description: Nonblank text of the address part.

address.description: Named address parts, such as sheet and cell, with nonblank text values.

source.description: UUID of the Source edition that contains this address.

Location.title: Location

MarketPath.description: One path, the member of a Paths document with its key.

amounts.description: The amounts of each declared series, in the order of the declarations.

key.description: Key of the path, unique in its document.

MarketPath.title: MarketPath

Measure.description: An identified definition of a measurable characteristic and its canonical units.

code.description: Case-sensitive code unique within the Model’s Measure collection; not reference identity.

definition.description: Optional explanatory text describing the measurement convention.

id.description: Stable identity of this Measure definition.

name.description: Nonblank human-readable name of the measured characteristic.

tags.description: Unordered, nonblank descriptive terms, with no duplicates.

units.description: Nonblank expression specifying the canonical units for quantities interpreted through this Measure, such as m^2 or AUD/year. Unitless quantities must have an explicit dimensionless convention.

Measure.title: Measure

Metadata.description: Identity, description, and optional lineage of one immutable document revision.

description.description: Optional explanation of this revision and its purpose.

id.description: UUID identifying the enclosing immutable document revision.

name.description: Optional human-readable name of this revision.

previous.description: UUID of the preceding revision of the same document kind, referencing its Metadata.

schema_version.description: Version of the enclosing document's schema contract.

Metadata.title: Metadata

Method.description: The named process used to assert, derive, or reconcile evidence.

code.description: Nonblank code that names the process.

description.description: Optional nonblank explanation of the process.

version.description: Optional nonblank version of the process.

Method.title: Method

MissingHandling.description: What a value projection does with an Entity that has no matching Value.
MissingHandling.title: MissingHandling

Model.description: A self-contained snapshot of a system's declarations, mathematical formulations, and recorded content, identified by its Metadata.

definitions.description: Canonical Taxonomy, Measure, and Function definitions referenced by this snapshot.

geometry.description: Optional exact Geometry pin and Entity mappings.

metadata.description: Required identity, schema contract version, and optional descriptive/history fields.

provenance.description: Evidence and reasoning supporting recorded domain and Value content in this snapshot.

system.description: The domain objects and explicit mathematical formulations represented by this Model.

Model.title: Model

Movement.description: One numerical entry in a Flow, associated with a date or period. The overall model logic determines its meaning. At least one of date or period is required. With a period, date records an independent payment or observation date and need not lie inside the period. Derived boundary dates are calculated, not stored. UUID identifies the Movement independently of dates and optional matching keys. Repeated event dates require distinct nonblank keys; keys are not reference identity. Magnitude omission/null means unresolved. Claims retain source or derivation evidence.

claims.description: Unique UUIDs of provenance Claims that support this Movement.

date.description: Date of the entry; with a period, an independent payment or observation date.

id.description: Stable Movement identity across Model revisions. Derived numerical results receive fresh identities.

key.description: Optional event matching key and readable label; never reference identity.

magnitude.description: Amount in the Flow units; absent or null means unresolved, and zero is a known amount.

Movement.title: Movement

Never.description: The one word for an event that does not happen. NEVER is a date-valued result, not a missing value; an absent date is unresolved.
Never.title: Never

Objective.description: A scalar numerical Expression and the sense in which its result is preferred.

expression.description: UUID of a scalar numerical Expression in the composed Model and Specification scope.

sense.description: Whether smaller or larger results are preferred.

Objective.title: Objective

ObjectiveKind.description: Whether an objective prefers smaller or larger results.
ObjectiveKind.title: ObjectiveKind

Observation.description: One value that a rule read on a window date, and when it became available.

available_on.description: The date from which the value was available; it is not after the date of the Check. Absent or null means always available, or undecided.

name.description: The text of what the condition reads, unique within its Check, such as rent_index or rent_index.shift(by=1).

target.description: The Value that the rule read, or the Movement for a reading of a Flow.

value.description: The value that the rule read. Absent or null means that the value was undecided, so the observation is unknown.

Observation.title: Observation

ObservationSource.description: Where the value that a rule read comes from.
ObservationSource.title: ObservationSource

Operator.description: The operator of a unary or binary Expression.
Operator.title: Operator

Parameter.description: A named argument in a Function signature. List order determines positional argument order.

kind.description: How a call may supply this parameter.

name.description: Parameter name, unique within the Function; named arguments bind by this name.

required.description: Whether a call must supply this argument.

Parameter.title: Parameter

ParameterKind.description: How a call supplies a Function argument.
ParameterKind.title: ParameterKind

PathAmounts.description: The amounts of one series in one path, one in each Period of the document.

magnitudes.description: Finite amount in each Period, in the units of the series and in the order of the Periods.

PathAmounts.title: PathAmounts

PathCapture.description: How a set of market paths was made. Paths made from data have no generator, parameters, seed or random streams.

algorithm.description: Random generation algorithm, such as numpy.SeedSequence/PCG64; absent when nothing is random.

count.description: Number of paths that were made.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the generator implementation; present exactly when the generator is.

generator.description: Registered name of the path generator, such as dynamics; absent for paths made from data.

parameters.description: The parameters of the generator for each series, in order.

seed.description: Nonnegative seed of the random streams; absent when nothing is random.

streams.description: The random streams of the generator, in order; empty when nothing is random.

versions.description: Versions of the libraries that made the paths.

PathCapture.title: PathCapture

PathCase.description: A reference to one path of a Paths document, and the Movements that each of its series fixes.

key.description: Key of the path in the Paths document.

series.description: Each series of the path that fixes a Flow value, in order.

PathCase.title: PathCase

PathParameter.description: One parameter of a path generator for one series, a constant or a distribution.

distribution.description: Distribution that each path draws the parameter from; give this or quantity, not both.

name.description: Name of the parameter, unique for its series.

quantity.description: Constant value of the parameter; give this or distribution, not both.

series.description: Name of the series that the parameter applies to.

PathParameter.title: PathParameter

PathSeries.description: The declaration of one named series of market paths, such as a rent index.

lag.description: Whole length of time, such as 0 days or 1 month, after which an amount is known. An amount is known at the end of its Period plus the lag.

name.description: Name of the series, unique in its document. A Model value with the same key takes the series.

units.description: Units of every amount of the series.

PathSeries.title: PathSeries

Paths.description: A captured, replayable set of market paths over one sequence of Periods, with its capture record. A path is one possible history of external conditions.

members.description: The paths, in order; the keys are unique.

metadata.description: Identity and schema version of this revision, with an optional name and description.

periods.description: The Periods of every series, in order; they do not overlap.

series.description: The declaration of each series that every member holds, in order; the names are unique.

Paths.title: Paths

Period.description: Half-open interval [start, end), which includes start and excludes end. Date boundaries use the Gregorian calendar; start must precede end.

end.description: Boundary date after the period; it is excluded and later than start.

start.description: First date of the period; it is included.

Period.title: Period

PeriodTiming.description: The date that represents a Period.
PeriodTiming.title: PeriodTiming

Projection.description: Select Entity identities or Values belonging to each matching Entity.

cardinality.description: Number of Values permitted for each Entity; required for value projection and absent for entity projection.

kind.description: Whether the query returns Entity identities or Values of the matching Entities.

measure.description: Select Values with this exact Measure.

missing.description: Treatment of an Entity with no matching Value; required for value projection and absent for entity projection.

Projection.title: Projection

ProjectionKind.description: Whether a Query returns Entity identities or their Values.
ProjectionKind.title: ProjectionKind

PropertyContent.description: Tagged inert content. Scalar text preserves exact type and representation, including negative zero. Containers never instantiate arbitrary Python classes. Conditional shape and canonical scalar grammar are checked semantically.

entries.description: Ordered entries of a mapping or mapping proxy; keys are unique.

fold.description: Fold, 0 or 1, of a datetime or time value; it selects between repeated wall-clock times.

items.description: Ordered members of a list, tuple, set or frozenset; set members use a canonical order.

kind.description: Type tag; it determines which other fields are present and how text is read.

text.description: Canonical text of a scalar value, such as an ISO date or a duration in microseconds; absent for null and container kinds.

zone.description: Optional IANA time-zone key of a datetime or time value.

PropertyContent.title: PropertyContent

Provenance.description: Facts connecting graph objects to supporting Claims, with the Sources and upstream Claims needed to follow their lineage.

claims.description: Claims referenced by Facts and by upstream Claim dependencies; each Claim is stored once.

facts.description: Facts that connect graph objects or characteristics to supporting Claims; at most one Fact per target.

sources.description: Source editions referenced by Claim Locations; each Source is stored once.

Provenance.title: Provenance

Quantity.description: Numerical content consisting of a finite magnitude and explicit units.

magnitude.description: Finite numerical magnitude expressed in the accompanying units.

units.description: Explicit units for this magnitude, such as m^2, AUD/year, or dimensionless.

Quantity.title: Quantity

Query.description: A non-executing query specification returning Entity or Value identities from the containing Model revision.

duplicates.description: Whether repeated projected UUIDs are kept or removed.

filter.description: Optional conditions applied to the candidates after traversal.

projection.description: Selection of Entity identities or Values from the filtered candidates.

starting_at.description: UUID of the Entity in the containing Model revision where the query starts.

steps.description: Ordered traversal steps; omission selects the starting Entity.

Query.title: Query

RandomStream.description: Stable identity of one random stream of a generator, independent of process and dispatch order.

identifier.description: SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the names that identify the stream; with the seed, it seeds the stream.

name.description: Name of the component or parameter that the stream draws for.

RandomStream.title: RandomStream

Reconciliation.description: Explicit selection of one supporting Claim when evidence conflicts.

method.description: Optional process used to make the selection.

selected.description: UUID of a Claim included in the Fact's claims.

status.description: Whether the selection is provisional or confirmed.

Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation

ReconciliationStatus.description: Whether a reconciled selection is provisional or confirmed.
ReconciliationStatus.title: ReconciliationStatus

Reference.description: A Value or Movement UUID resolved in the containing Model or composed Specification. Execution diagnostic references resolve in the Run's input Model. Names, matching keys and positions are never identities.

target.description: UUID of a Value or Movement declaration in the applicable scope.

Reference.title: Reference

Relationship.description: An identified, directed connection from one Entity to another. Its classification describes the connection; its characteristics describe properties of the connection itself.

characteristics.description: Labels and Values describing this connection.

classification.description: Classification describing the object, referenced by its stable UUID.

id.description: Stable identity of the Relationship across Model revisions.

Relationship.title: Relationship

Report.description: Outcome, actual runtime, findings, and ordered execution trace of a Run.

diagnostics.description: Unordered findings supporting interpretation of the outcome.

rule_evidence.description: The decision trace of the rules of this case; absent for a case without rules and for a batch.

runtime.description: Actual runtime when known; may be absent for a skipped or pre-execution failure.

trace.description: Ordered execution and selection records; list order is preserved.

Report.title: Report

Rule.description: One rule as a query over a window of dates. On each path it fixes one value on the first window date on which its condition holds, or fixes otherwise.

condition.description: Boolean Expression that the rule tests on each window date. It reads Values, parameters and the values of earlier rules.

earliest.description: Inclusive first bound of the window, a date Expression. An Expression that reads an undecided value keeps the window closed. Absent or null means no bound.

latest.description: Inclusive last bound of the window, a date Expression. An Expression that reads an undecided value keeps the window open. Absent or null means no bound.

otherwise.description: Literal Expression that the target takes when no window date meets the condition, a quantity, a date or NEVER.

periods.description: Nonempty ordered Periods that give the calendar of the window. Absent or null means that the window acts when a value that the condition reads becomes known.

target.description: The Value that the rule decides, a date Value or a scalar measurement Value.

then.description: Literal Expression that the target takes when the condition holds. Absent or null means the window date itself, which fits a date Value only.

timing.description: The day of each Period that is its window date. Absent or null means the first day. It needs periods.

Rule.title: Rule

RuleEvidence.description: The decision trace of one case, its decided values, its solve count and the result of its trace check (ADR-021).

checks.description: One record for each window date and each otherwise, in the order in which they ran.

decided.description: The value of each rule that fixed its value, in the order of the decisions.

provisional_solves.description: The number of provisional solves that the rules needed. The final solve of the case is one more.

verified.description: Whether the trace check passed on a candidate. False means that the case has no candidate, or that the check found a difference.

RuleEvidence.title: RuleEvidence

Run.description: The finalized record of one execution attempt against an exact Specification revision.

metadata.description: Identity and schema version of this immutable Run record.

outputs.description: Unique accepted output Model revision references, or their union for a batch.

paths.description: UUID of the Paths revision whose series fix the cases of this Run; absent when no case takes a path.

spawns.description: Unique references to directly spawned Run revisions.

specification.description: Exact attempted Specification revision, resolved as a Specification document.

Run.title: Run

RunStatus.description: Execution completion and mathematical conclusion of a Run, recorded independently.

completion.description: How this attempt ended, or the aggregate completion of a batch.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus

Runtime.description: Observed timing, implementation identities, and effective numerical settings.

finished_at.description: Observed finish instant with an explicit timezone.

implementations.description: Actual implementation identities; nonempty when Runtime is present.

settings.description: Effective numerical settings, rather than merely copied requests.

started_at.description: Observed start instant with an explicit timezone.

Runtime.title: Runtime

Selection.description: Read a declared member or indexed element from structured expression content.

base.description: Expression whose structured content supplies the member or element.

kind.description: Whether the selection reads a declared member or an indexed element.

Selection.title: Selection

SelectionKind.description: Whether a selection reads a declared member or an indexed element.
SelectionKind.title: SelectionKind

SeriesBinding.description: One path series and the Flow Value whose Movements it fixes, one Movement for each Period of the paths.

movements.description: The Movement of the Value that each Period of the paths fixes, in the order of the Periods.

value.description: The Flow Value that the series fixes.

SeriesBinding.title: SeriesBinding

Settings.description: Numerical convergence and resource settings; the containing record distinguishes requested from effective values.

iteration_limit.description: Maximum number of solver iterations requested, interpreted by the backend's documented algorithm.

relative_tolerance.description: Positive finite dimensionless convergence tolerance, strictly less than one.

time_limit.description: Positive finite execution time limit in seconds, using the backend's documented timing convention.

Settings.title: Settings

Severity.description: How much a Diagnostic affects the interpretation of a result.
Severity.title: Severity

SolutionStatus.description: The mathematical conclusion of a Run.
SolutionStatus.title: SolutionStatus

Source.description: An identifiable edition of an external evidence artifact.

author.description: Optional nonblank author of the evidence artifact.

checksum.description: Content checksum identifying the evidence edition.

id.description: Stable identity of the Source edition, referenced by Locations.

issued_at.description: Optional date or date-time at which the source edition was issued.

name.description: Nonblank human-readable name of the evidence artifact.

received_at.description: Optional date or date-time at which the source edition was received.

Source.title: Source

Span.description: Named extent, using the same half-open boundary convention as Period.

end.description: Boundary date after the period; it is excluded and later than start.

name.description: Optional name of the extent.

start.description: First date of the period; it is included.

Span.title: Span

Specification.description: An immutable contribution of investigation requirements, a composition of such contributions, or a batch of separate Specifications. A concrete composition investigates one pinned Model revision.

assignments.description: Explicit Quantities held fixed on their target Values for this investigation.

cases.description: Unique Metadata UUIDs of separate Specifications in a batch, without implicit inheritance.

estimates.description: Initial numerical estimates for unknown Values, used to initialize a solve without fixing them.

formulations.description: Additional mathematical declarations and constraints owned by this Specification. Root codes are unique within this collection, independently of the Model's root Formulation codes.

includes.description: Unique Metadata UUIDs of Specification revisions contributing requirements to this investigation.

metadata.description: Identity and schema version of this Specification revision, with optional description and lineage.

model.description: UUID of the exact input Model revision. Optional on a contribution; required after composing a concrete investigation. On a batch it only asserts every case's independently supplied input Model.

objectives.description: Objectives in decreasing order of preference. Implementations may use this order for automatic selection; candidate exploration and final selection are implementation responsibilities.

path.description: The market path whose series fix Flow values in this case. The resolve-cases stage expands it into assignments from the Paths document; the case does not copy the amounts.

rules.description: Nonempty ordered rules, each a query over a window that decides one value. They run in this order. A decided value has no other role.

settings.description: Optional numerical requests. Choices still unspecified after composition are left to the implementation; the Run records the effective settings.

unknowns.description: Unique scalar or Movement unknowns; explicit and disjoint from assignments and rule targets.

Specification.title: Specification

Step.description: One ordered record of execution activity, without prescribing scheduling or rule logic.

at.description: Observed event instant with an explicit timezone.

document.description: Revision containing the referenced target, or the document addressed as a whole.

message.description: What occurred and the basis for any selection.

target.description: UUID of a canonical record in document; never an unqualified cross-revision reference.

Step.title: Step

StepKind.description: The kind of an execution step that a Run records.
StepKind.title: StepKind

System.description: The Entities, Relationships, Assemblies, and mathematical formulations of a Model.

assemblies.description: Canonical Assemblies with UUID references to shared domain members.

entities.description: Canonical domain Entities, excluding Assemblies stored in their own collection.

formulations.description: Canonical root Formulations containing governing mathematical declarations and constraints.

relationships.description: Canonical directed connections between Entities, including Assemblies.

System.title: System

Taxonomy.description: A named, single-root hierarchy of Classifications.

classifications.description: Identified Classifications belonging to this Taxonomy; codes are unique within the collection.

code.description: Case-sensitive code unique in the Model's taxonomy catalogue.

id.description: Stable identity of the Taxonomy across Model revisions.

name.description: Nonblank human-readable name.

Taxonomy.title: Taxonomy

TraceValue.description: One value in a decision trace, a Quantity, a calendar date or NEVER.

date.description: The calendar date of a date Value; it excludes quantity and never.

never.description: The value of a date Value when the event does not happen; it excludes quantity and date.

quantity.description: The amount of a scalar Value or a Movement; it excludes date and never.

TraceValue.title: TraceValue

Traversal.description: One traversal step over domain Relationships or Assembly membership.

classification.description: Exact Classification of Relationships to follow.

depth.description: Whether the step follows exactly one edge or one or more edges.

direction.description: Direction in which to follow Relationships; required for relationship steps and absent for membership steps.

kind.description: Whether the step follows classified Relationships or Assembly membership.

Traversal.title: Traversal

TraversalKind.description: Whether a traversal step follows Relationships or Assembly membership.
TraversalKind.title: TraversalKind

Value.description: An identified, typed Value belonging to an Entity or Relationship's Characteristics, or declared locally within a mathematical Formulation. Its key provides a name within the owner's values collection; its UUID identifies the symbol independently of that name.

content.description: Inert typed content of a property Value.

date.description: Recorded calendar date of a date Value; absent when the date is unresolved or NEVER.

description.description: Explanation of the meaning of this Value within its owner.

flow.description: Temporal quantities of a flow Value.

id.description: Stable identity of the Value, used by provenance Facts.

inferred.description: True when a draft worked out the kind, units and Periods of this Value from the equation that defines it, because no call declared them; a later revision works them out again. Absent or false when they were declared, and are a check of the equations.

key.description: Nonblank name unique within the owner's values collection; not reference identity.

kind.description: The kind of content represented by this characteristic.

measure.description: Measure defining meaning and canonical units, referenced by its stable UUID.

never.description: Records that the event of a date Value does not happen; it excludes date.

quantity.description: Optional recorded numerical content. Its units must be compatible with the Measure's canonical units. Omission or null denotes unresolved content.

Value.title: Value

ValueRelation.description: How a ValueTest relates the recorded Value to its operands. The comparisons use the words of Operator.
ValueRelation.title: ValueRelation

ValueTest.description: One test of the recorded measurement Value with an owner-local key, after conversion to the units of the test.

key.description: Owner-local key of the tested Value.

maximum.description: Inclusive upper bound of between; absent for other relations.

minimum.description: Inclusive lower bound of between; absent for other relations.

quantity.description: Operand of a comparison; absent for between, present and missing.

relation.description: How the recorded Value relates to the operands.

ValueTest.title: ValueTest
